Definition: a Pelonite or inhabitant of an unknown Palon
BiblicalUsage: Peloniy is a Pelonite, a man from an unknown Palon. Helez the Pelonite and Ahijah the Pelonite stand in the list of David's mighty men, named and counted among the thirty.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that God counts men from places no one can find on a map: Helez and Ahijah are Pelonites, and they are mighty men all the same.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
